in_english.name: Altufayl
in_english.meaning: Means small or child in Arabic origin
in_english.long_meaning: Altufayl is a male given name of Arabic origin, meaning small or child. It is derived from the Arabic root 'ṭ-f-l' (طفل), which signifies a child or young one. Historically, the name has been associated with innocence and purity. In Islamic tradition, the name Altufayl holds significance as it was a kunya (nickname) of the Prophet Muhammad, highlighting its revered status among Muslims. The name symbolizes new beginnings and is often chosen for its spiritual connotations.
